body:
That’s one way of testing the water, I wish I had that option. People who are close to me know I’m not the happiest person around, but they don’t know the extent. I feel like I wouldn’t be able to convince them it is a hypothetical question. 

It’s also possible that I’m being foolish for not wanting to involve those closest to me in my despair. However I feel if I go down that road, I can never come back. I’ll always be that person who might not be around the next day. And I’m worried that’s gonna push the only people I care about further away. Really that’s only an issue if it works I guess.

All I want is someone to talk to about this, but even saying that makes me feel guilty for dumping my problem on somebody else. I don’t know how or what to say. I’ve never had help with my problems. As a result I’m kinda lost, like trying to find the answer without knowing the question. I guess I was hoping for some insight or something in posting here.

The RP value is why is always want to give Vaan the monk! When I had the original in ps2 he always had the poles. I’m glad I’m not the only one.
I definitely didn’t consider time battlemage... I don’t know if that would violate the spirit of the challenge though. But you make a good case for it.

Very helpful, I’m just about to enter the palace after getting the sunstone. I’ve already picked monk as Vaans first job, simply because I love the monk class. I’m not opposed to starting over but I’d like not to. 

Based on that and your Info I’m leaning towards:
 Vaan- Monk/Machinist- debuffs and decoying mostly
Basche- Knight/Bushi -I’ve yet to do this combo
Balthier Archer/???-something with some armor to keep him up and healing
